$comment: Catalog v6 (2026-07-31, per Bri) — 15 items, all prices globally unique so any revealed amount identifies the item. Laws: one clause referencing core rules only; no rare triggers (an item acts the day it is bought or on an event that happens most rounds); stores stay mixed-purpose; dual-use where possible. Items with an "aim" field need a second, server-private action (p/aim) because a purchase carries only an amount — never a target. The werebear may buy anything, silver included. Economy: 50 XLM buy-in, +15 XLM/day.

items.label: Horseshoe nail
items.effect: Lucky iron: if the vote ties on you, the tie falls on the other. One nail, one escape.

items.label: Cold iron key
items.flavor: Fits more doors than it should.
items.effect: Aim it: one villager finds one store locked to them tomorrow. The village learns which store was locked, never who turned the key.

items.label: Silver charm
items.flavor: Grandmother swore by it. Grandmother is dead.
items.effect: Survive one night attack. The charm shatters, everyone hears it, and you spend the next day in bed — too weak to vote.

general_store.label: General Store
general_store.subtitle: Everything you need. Nothing you can explain.

items.label: A bottle
items.effect: Loose lips: at dawn the morning report carries one true rumour about the day's shopping. You don't choose which.

items.label: The ledger book
items.flavor: Somebody has to keep the books.
items.effect: Tax records: at dawn, Maude names who spent the most today. Names only — amounts stay sealed.

items.label: Musk salve
items.effect: Shop unseen: tomorrow the sightings log your store visits as a hooded figure instead of your name. Anyone may buy it. Anyone.

items.label: Shopkeeper's holiday
items.flavor: Everyone deserves a rest. Tomorrow, ideally.
items.effect: Aim it: that shopkeeper closes tomorrow and sells to nobody. The whole village sees the shutters.

items.label: Sock in mouth
items.flavor: Clean, mostly. That is not the point.
items.effect: Aim it: that villager may still talk and defend themselves, but their vote does not count at today's trial.

items.label: Soup bone
items.flavor: Somebody else's dog will love you for it.
items.effect: Aim it: leave the bone at another villager's gate. If the beast comes for you tonight, one chance in four it goes there instead.

items.label: The butcher's knife
items.effect: Conviction, sharpened: your vote counts twice at today's trial. Everyone hears a knife being ground; nobody knows whose.

items.label: Tooth sharpener
items.flavor: Ask no questions about the previous owner.
items.effect: Werebear: tonight nothing saves your prey. Villager: leave it out as an offering — an even chance the beast takes it and spares you.

items.label: Gerald's finger
items.flavor: The Order swears it is his. The Order swears a lot.
items.effect: Does nothing. Absolutely nothing — though the village still sees you visit.

items.label: Lantern oil
items.flavor: Gerald's lantern was still lit, you know.
items.effect: Posthumous: if you are eaten, Maude reads one true fact about the werebear's purchases by your still-lit lantern.

items.label: Unsealing ritual
items.flavor: The Order charges for the truth.
items.effect: At dawn, Maude unseals ONE purchase of the day's most-accused villager and names the item. The vote picks the target; the ritual pays for the reading.

items.label: Unquiet rest
items.flavor: The Order accepts coin for almost anything.
items.effect: Pay the Order early: when you die, an even chance your ghost returns with a vote. Either way, the village is told.

items.label: The long candle
items.flavor: Burns all night. Sees about half of it.
items.effect: Aim it: an even chance the flame shows you truly whether that villager is the werebear. Otherwise it gutters and tells you nothing.
